title: Tooling: 15× faster production sparse-fusion screen via spectator orbits with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, `scripts/audit_sparse_fusion.py:central_gate_screen` still summed exact binary ranks over every weight-three indicator. ToikY’s opt-in adapter `research/sparse-fusion-orbits/` already proved an exact spectator-orbit reduction with identical receipts. This PR wires that equivalent check into the **production** source used by `make verify`.

`certificates/sparse-fusion-audit.json` stays **byte-identical** (this audit has no `source_sha256` map). Every screen field, all 4,096 joint-frame inequalities, finite phase identities, candidate budgets and the retained historical language are unchanged.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs gave median wall time:

- **screen-only:** **0.661 → 0.044 seconds (15.05×)**
- **complete certificate:** **0.608 → 0.060 seconds (10.07×)**

Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Screen receipts at `h∈{22,25,28}` and the committed certificate match the baseline checker byte-for-byte.

Package: `research/sparse-fusion-orbits-production/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/sparse-fusion-orbits-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/sparse-fusion-orbits-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sparse-fusion-orbits-production
python3.12 -I -B research/sparse-fusion-orbits-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SPARSE_FUSION_ORBITS_PRODUCTION screen_heights=[22, 25, 28] screen_cases=3 certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/sparse-fusion-orbits-production outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_SPARSE_FUSION_ORBITS_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Orbit-cover, weight-omission and admission controls reject; `require` gates remain under `-O`. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): ToikY’s `research/sparse-fusion-orbits/` (opt-in orbit adapter; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2194) / [#2210](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2210) (same production-promotion pattern on other objects). No competing open PR on production `central_gate_screen` at refresh.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the sparse/fusion screen and original checker. ToikY authored the orbit algorithm. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
